verdict.rationale: HelixDB documents filtering an exact candidate set before vector ranking, and supports search and filtering on both nodes and edges. This suggests filtered vector search keeps its results within the filter rather than dropping matches through post-filtering. The evidence is thin, short claimed-docs snippets with no detail on how property filters are expressed and nothing on how latency or recall behave under selective filters. Missing for 10: documentation of metadata/property filter syntax combined with vector search, recall/latency benchmarks under filtering, and independent hands-on corroboration.
